title: FollowupAnswer
description: A short source-linked answer to one follow-up question, written only from the passages of this research the application selected and sent in this call. Claims cite only passage IDs from the StepInput allowlist, each with an exact contiguous anchor. `not_answered` says the given passages do not answer the question; it starts no search. Locators and reading depth come from backend Passage records, never from this output. Passing structural checks is not semantic verification.

outcome.description: answered: the given passages answer the question. partly_answered: they answer part of it; name the rest in unanswered_aspects. not_answered: they do not answer it; claims may still report what the closest passages state.

support_type.description: source_stated: the cited passages state it. analyst_inference: an interpretation drawn from the cited passages.

citation_anchors.description: Exact contiguous source text used to locate the supporting sentence in the cited passage. One anchor is required for each claim-passage pair.

report_change_requested.description: true when the follow-up asks for the research's report itself to change (add, remove, extend, shorten, restructure or rewrite part of it), not only for an answer in the conversation. The application then writes a new report version that follows the request; this answer is still written. false for a question that only asks to be answered.

new_works_requested.description: true when the follow-up asks for works, studies or sources beyond the ones supplied (other studies, more or newer papers, work that also covers something the supplied works do not). The application then offers the person a search for new works; it starts nothing by itself. false when the follow-up asks about the supplied works.

work_classifications.description: Only for a follow-up that counts, lists, groups or sorts works into categories: one record per work, identified by a passage of that work from this StepInput. A classified record puts the work in one or more groups (at most 6 distinct groups across the answer), each membership with an exact anchor in a passage of the same source. ambiguous and insufficient_evidence records carry no membership and say why in note. The application counts the works per group; never write a count in a claim. Empty for any other question.

more_queries.description: Only when conversation.more_queries_allowed is true and the outcome is not answered: up to three short search phrases for passages this research holds but did not send. The application ranks its library with them and asks once more. It starts no search for new works. Empty otherwise.
